summary: Walkthrough of Sprint 8: Strategic Alignment & Capabilities Matrix. This sprint focused on positioning Cohezion for the Anthropic 'Universes' Research Engineer role. Key achievements include the creation of a comprehensive Capabilities Matrix, the standardization of the 71+ skill substrate, the implementation of Journey Narration for agent interpretability, and a deep-dive analysis of 119 captured experiences in SurrealDB. The project's documentation has been refined to showcase its unique technical edge in high-dimensional agentic stability.
